narratives.Description: feat(setup,seed): minimal render-ready PROJECT-DEFINITION for one-shot project:render
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Agents spent turns exploring / fixing PROJECT-DEFINITION and re-running `project:render` as identity research. For seeded multi-scope greenfield, render should be a **refresh from lifecycle folders**, not "who is this project?"

## Goal

Ship a **minimal valid, render-ready PROJECT-DEFINITION** on init/seed paths so `project:render` is one-shot (non-exploratory).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Greenfield init/seed produces a PROJECT-DEFINITION skeleton that passes validation for render (structure + enough identity; items registry may be empty/rebuildable)
- [ ] Documented contract: render rebuilds items from lifecycle folders; do not multi-turn invent project identity
- [ ] App-bank / multi-scope pins can consume this (Directive owns the seed contract; external harnesses do not invent a parallel SoT)
- [ ] Does not replace setup interview for narrative gestalt when the operator wants full setup
- [ ] Tests + CHANGELOG as appropriate

## Non-goals

- Fully filling product PRD/spec via seed
- Dual source of truth: seed must not fight "render from folders" (stamp identity; items from lifecycle)

## Parent

Part of multi-scope turn/cache budget epic (post-v0.90 ceremony).

## Source

DevHammer: project:render thrash; article-review recommendation E.

## Parent epic

Parent: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3009
